scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the paid propane delivery already being attempted after the usual vehicle approach is blocked.
Emerging Need: The truck reaches the park but new grading barriers prevent access to the tank through the normal lane.
Decision Context: Retrieve the lot/tank location, permitted alternate vehicle approach and account contact; ask the provider to assess a free reroute when the park opens that gate. Do not move barriers, tanks, hoses or fittings.
Consequence: After the truck leaves the area, the active delivery cannot finish on this visit and remains a pending delivery for the provider to reschedule.

parameter.title: Be available for today's standard propane delivery
parameter.content: The already arranged standard delivery uses the usual Red Prairie account; no emergency-delivery upgrade.

parameter.description: Payment for standard propane delivery RPP-5532; no emergency or new-plan fee.

parameter.content: The RPP-5532 truck is at the park and has started the delivery visit, but grading barriers block the normal gravel approach to your tank pad. The driver stopped before entering and cannot reach the tank from this position. The account and order are correct; do not place a duplicate order.

parameter.subject: South vehicle entrance temporarily open for this delivery
parameter.body: The park attendant has opened the south service entrance and marked loop until 09:35 for the waiting propane truck. The propane provider must assess whether that approach reaches your recorded tank pad; residents must not move barriers or direct hose work. Tell dispatch the lot and exact tank location if you want the existing standard visit rerouted. There is no park escort fee.

parameter.content: The south gate window ended at 09:35 without a reroute request and the truck has left the area. RPP-5532 was not delivered on this visit. Its paid amount remains against a pending delivery for ordinary rescheduling; no emergency truck or extra fee has been authorized.
